options.name: boot_order
options.description: This option uses complex arguments and is a list of items that specify the bootorder.

options.name: cd_drive
options.description: The CD you wish to have mounted on the VM when O(state=cd).

options.name: cluster
options.description: The RHEV/oVirt cluster in which you want you VM to start.

options.name: cpu_share
options.description: This parameter is used to configure the CPU share.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The RHEV/oVirt datacenter in which you want you VM to start.

options.name: del_prot
options.description: This option sets the delete protection checkbox.

options.name: disks
options.description: This option uses complex arguments and is a list of disks with the options V(name), V(size), and V(domain).

options.name: ifaces
options.description: This option uses complex arguments and is a list of interfaces with the options V(name) and V(vlan).

options.name: image
options.description: The template to use for the VM.

options.name: insecure_api
options.description: A boolean switch to make a secure or insecure connection to the server.

options.name: mempol
options.description: The minimum amount of memory you wish to reserve for this system.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the VM.

options.name: osver
options.description: The operating system option in RHEV/oVirt.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for user authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which the API is reachable.

options.name: server
options.description: The name/IP of your RHEV-m/oVirt instance.

options.name: state
options.description: This serves to create/remove/update or powermanage your VM.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout you wish to define for power actions. When O(state=up). When O(state=down). When O(state=restarted).

options.name: type
options.description: To define if the VM is a server or desktop.

options.name: user
options.description: The user to authenticate with.

options.name: vm_ha
options.description: To make your VM High Available.

options.name: vmcpu
options.description: The number of CPUs you want in your VM.

options.name: vmhost
options.description: The host you wish your VM to run on.

options.name: vmmem
options.description: The amount of memory you want your VM to use (in GB).
